def print_next_greater_freq(arr, n):
    from collections import Counter
    
    # Calculate the frequency of each element in the array
    freq = Counter(arr)
    
    # Stack to keep track of elements and their indices
    stack = []
    result = [-1] * n
    
    for i in range(n):
        # While stack is not empty and the current element has a greater frequency
        # than the element at the index stored at the top of the stack
        while stack and freq[arr[i]] > freq[arr[stack[-1]]]:
            result[stack.pop()] = arr[i]
        
        # Push the current index onto the stack
        stack.append(i)
